# Sevens Cleaners

> Professional, on-demand residential cleaning service serving the Greater Houston area. Book online in minutes, pay securely, and get real-time updates from your cleaner.

Sevens Cleaners is a residential cleaning company that lets customers book, pay, and track cleanings entirely online — no phone calls required. All cleaners are vetted, background-checked, and insured. Flat-rate pricing with no hidden fees. SMS and email updates keep customers informed from booking to completion.

## Services

- **1 Bedroom Clean** — $120, approx. 90 minutes. Full standard clean of a 1-bedroom home or apartment.
- **2 Bedroom Clean** — $175, approx. 120 minutes. Full standard clean of a 2-bedroom home or apartment.

Every standard clean includes: kitchen counters, sink, stovetop & appliances; bathrooms (toilet, tub/shower, vanity, mirrors); all rooms dusted, vacuumed & mopped; trash emptied; beds made; interior windows cleaned.

## Optional Add-Ons

- **Deep Clean** — +$50, +45 min. Baseboards, inside cabinets, window sills, and all the spots a regular clean skips.
- **Extra Bedroom** — +$40, +30 min. Add a third or more bedroom for a full, thorough clean throughout.
- **Inside Oven** — +$25, +20 min. Degrease and scrub burnt residue so your oven looks and smells brand new.
- **Inside Fridge** — +$25, +20 min. Wipe shelves, drawers, and walls — fresh, odor-free, and ready to stock.
- **Move In / Move Out** — +$75, +60 min. Top-to-bottom deep clean to get your deposit back or start fresh in a new place.
- **Pet Hair** — +$30, +20 min. Specialized tools to lift stubborn pet hair and dander from floors and furniture.

## How to Book

1. Go to the booking page at /book
2. Select a service (1 Bedroom or 2 Bedroom)
3. Choose any add-ons
4. Enter your address and preferred date/time window
5. Pay securely via Stripe
6. Receive SMS and email confirmation immediately

Booking takes under 3 minutes. No account required.

## Why Sevens Cleaners

- Fully vetted, background-checked cleaners
- Flat-rate pricing — no hourly surprises
- Real-time SMS and email updates (on the way, arrived, done)
- Satisfaction guaranteed — we return within 24 hours if anything is missed
- Fully insured
- Promo codes accepted at checkout

## Service Area

Greater Houston, Texas, USA.
